# Overview

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "bcms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Implementation = "bcms-implementation.html",
    Theory = "bcms-theory.html"
  )
)
```

```{r bcms_overview, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_overview(
  family = "bcms",
  summary = paste(
    "The bent-cylinder modal-series model (`BCMS`) calculates near-broadside",
    "scattering from straight or uniformly bent circular cylinders while",
    "retaining the `FCMS` cross-sectional modal solution."
  ),
  core_idea = paste(
    "Use the straight-cylinder partial-wave coefficients locally, then replace",
    "the straight axial coherence factor with the Fresnel-integral correction",
    "for uniform curvature [@Stanton_1989_2]."
  ),
  best_for = c(
    "Uniformly bent, constant-radius cylinders near broadside",
    paste(
      "Isolating curvature-driven coherence changes from cross-sectional",
      "boundary physics"
    ),
    "Comparisons with the straight `FCMS` limit"
  ),
  supports = c(
    "`Cylinder` shapes carried by `FLS` or `GAS` scatterers",
    "Curvature supplied through the shape's radius-of-curvature ratio",
    "Liquid-filled, gas-filled, fixed-rigid, and pressure-release boundaries"
  ),
  assumptions = c(
    "Uniform centerline curvature and constant circular cross-section",
    "Broadside or near-broadside incidence",
    "Curvature changes axial coherence but not local modal coefficients",
    paste(
      "No arbitrary bending, torsion, taper, or fully three-dimensional",
      "boundary solve"
    )
  ),
  reading = c(
    paste(
      "[Implementation](bcms-implementation.html): curvature input,",
      "boundaries, output, and internal checks"
    ),
    paste(
      "[Theory](bcms-theory.html): Fresnel coherence correction and the",
      "straight-cylinder limit"
    )
  )
)
```
